residual_risks: This is the first task to seal evidence under gate G4 -- reports/evidence/G4/MANIFEST.json is created fresh by this task, mirroring the schema OCOR-DEV-0028 established for the first G3 manifest.

The closed type grammar (string, integer, number, boolean, list) is deliberately minimal, matching 'the smallest contract-compliant implementation'; it is not a claim of covering every type the eventual full OAC grammar will need, only enough to prove the type-checking discipline itself (declare, satisfy, or be rejected).

The 'references' field and cycle/resolution checking are new semantic constructs this task introduces, distinct from CompilerRequest's own sealed external dependency-lock import resolution (which OCOR-DEV-0028 already exercises); both are exercised here without modifying CompilerRequest itself.

A genuine design bug was found and fixed before this evidence was sealed: require_resolved_references' sealed uniqueness check on 'referenced' would have wrongly rejected any legitimate diamond reference graph (two resources sharing one common referenced target) as a duplicate-resource error -- see the commands log above.

DiagnosticCode values NON_DETERMINISTIC_OUTPUT, ARTIFACT_DRIFT, SIGNATURE_INVALID and RELEASE_REJECTED remain out of this task's scope: NON_DETERMINISTIC_OUTPUT and RELEASE_REJECTED are already exercised structurally by the sealed verify_deterministic_build/CanonicalIrRelease.create() helpers this task reuses; ARTIFACT_DRIFT and SIGNATURE_INVALID belong to the not-yet-implemented IrSigner/ArtifactGenerator/CompatibilityChecker protocols, which remain unimplemented sealed Protocols, same as OCOR-DEV-0028 left them.
